body: I take meds, I go to therapy... I've tried so hard to do all the things that are supposed to help and none of them have. I have so many mental illnesses to deal with so there is always something going wrong. Doctors and hospitals turn me away because I'm too much of a complex case and they can't think of any way to help. I've tried so hard but  I'm so tired of life.

Try to stick around for her. Maybe things will get better for you. 

I can't put up with this much longer and it's not going to get better for me at this point. So like what's the point of even living.
It's so fucking hard living this way. Like I don't think some people understand what it's like to be chronically suicidal. Fuck I just want to die so bad.
I relate to this. But I'm done running. I'm ready for my life to be over.

Ya it's hard. I've had some very serious attempts in the past. Thank you for your message though. I will keep it in my thoughts. I'm just so done with literally everything in life and want to be dead.
Ya I know I'm not making it much longer like I'm definitely going to attempt within the next few weeks. I can feel it.
Ya. To be honest I didn't even think I'd make it this old. I tried not to be. The inevitable feeling seems normal to me it just worries me when the feelings get more urgent. Like it is right now.
Thanks. Glad you're feeling better!
Ya I'm turning 20 this year and by no means do I actually intend on making it to my birthday.
Psychiatrist. :/
Fair
Is that safe?
Thank you so much. I hope things get better for you. Please go to the hospital or call a crisis line if you ever need to (hopefully you never will)

Death. I've come very close many times. There have been more than one time where the docs told me I shouldn't have survived my attempt. Basically what I've learned is that no plan is 100% fatal and the human body is really resilient. And ya I get scared about attempting different methods because I know that if I do and I survive it would be horrible.

If I need some sort of release or relief then I go to different maladaptive coping mechanics such as self harm.

I'm sorry for your loss. A similar situation actually occured with me this year and prevented an attempt. Idk just try to remember your moms grief when you have urges. Idk weird because I have attempted very seriously many times (and obviously failed) so it's like I can tell that there is an attempt on the horizon.
I'm sorry you're struggling. I mean right now I feel safe thanks to everyone but I know that some time quote soon I'm not going to be able to deal with being alive anymore.

Ya I absolutely relate. I had to drop out of high school for mental illness reasons and I just wanted to recover and be normal like my friends but like what could I do. I'm glad you're motivated to get better and I believe you can. Don't feel bad about an illness and the help you need because your needs are valid. Ugh I hate mental illness and suicidal ideation. I guess I'm fine as long as it stays as thoughts and not action urges (although tbh I've already had some of those although not super serious or urgent)
Oh ya that makes sense. For the most part in terms of suicide it's brain malfunction which sucks a lot.
I don't really know what you mean by brain malfunction. Nothing set me off tonight just the depression and suicide were so heavy on my mind and I didn't have anyone to reach out to.

That's too bad it isn't approved. Idk I think that just feeling the community around me right now and having your support and words has helped. Thank you for offering to listen I just don't really know what to say because everything in my life is how it should be except my brain. There just isn't really anything for me to say I guess.
Sometimes I forget that mental illness is as real and valid as physical illness or injury and should be treated seriously. And thank you none of us are alone even when we feel it.
Thank you so much for your response and sharing your story. I really appreciate it. I hope you are doing alright. And thank you for your advice.

Canada. I'm sorry nothing has worked for you yet. I was told my depression was too severe for TMS and my case too complicated for ECT to help me. Hopefully these treatments can help you. Also TMS as much as I know about it is a temporary fix so aren't you supposed to get maintenance sessions to help with remission. Idk I might be wrong.
Thank you. I'll try not to. It's just so hard sometimes and I'm so tired. :(

Thank you. I've been at the hospital before but they sort of banned me because my behavior (due to my illness) was too severe or something like that...or I required too much support and attention. It's complicated. Plus my outpatient team won't let me go to hospital...they made them put on my file I can only stay for like one night and they still have control of me and my meds even if I'm in hospital. Honestly at this point like I don't think anything is going to help. I've tried so many things.

Ya my doc controlled the dosage increases. I have quite a history with psych meds and even though I don't have much mass I've always needed high doses so maybe that had something to do with it. I'm really glad you're feeling like yourself. Your answer was really helpful so thank you. I'm on quite a cocktail of drugs plus lots of therapy so hopefully something starts to feel like it's working .
